column1: # The window grant lines the Companion module sends, held to Stagewatch from both ends. The module's tests press window_grant with
# each row's options and expect exactly the line, sent with a request id (test/module.test.mjs); Stagewatch's suite reads each line as
# its Companion server does (tokenized, then ShowCommandParser) and expects the window action, the window and the app, then sends every
# press line to a real Companion server with a request id and expects the door row's answer (CompanionV2Tests). A door row says what
# Companion TCP's door does with a line of that action: refused, with Stagewatch's words exactly (the module's log shows them after
# "refused —"); passes on to the show thread, whose receipt is the show's; or asked of the operator. A refuse row is a press the
# module answers in its log with those first words, sending nothing.
# A grant is a person's act (Show Bus 12.4) and Companion TCP proves no person, so its door asks it of the operator: the grant waits on
# Stagewatch's desk as a proposal, named by the window and the app's Show Bus id (an app's name is refused before it is sent). The
# door answers at once "accepted" in the asked row's first words, and once a person decides, its final follow-up — here a rejection,
# in the row's last words (p<n> is the proposal's number).
# door<TAB>action<TAB>refused|passes|asked<TAB>words (refused, asked: the accepted words)<TAB>the final words once rejected (asked)
